data.name: Benedek
data.gender_notes: Benedek is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Benedek means 'the Lord has blessed'. This name is derived from the Hebrew word 'benedic', which means 'to bless'. The name was borne by several figures in the Old Testament, including a grandson of Jacob and a high priest during the Babylonian exile. The name Benedek carries the meaning “Blessed, The Lord Blessed” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Benedek usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed, the lord blessed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with the blessings of God.
data.etymology: Benedek belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed, The Lord Blessed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Benedek total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: בנדק
in_hebrew.meaning: בן דק - בן meaning בן (son) ו דק (blessed)
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בנדק הוא שילוב של שתי מילים עבריות: בן (בן) ו- דק (ברך, ברכה). הוא נגזר מהמילה 'ברוך' שפירושה 'ברכה' או 'מבורך'. השם בנדק משמש כנראה כמקביל לעברית של השם הבנדיקטיני, שמקורו בלטינית ומשמעותו 'מבורך'. השימוש בשם זה בקרב הנוצרים הוא ככל הנראה היסטורי וקשור לכנסייה הקתולית.

in_greek.name: Βενέδεκ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Βενέδεκ είναι η ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος Βενδικτός (Benedictus), που σημαίνει 'ο ευλογημένος' ή 'ευλογημένος'. Αυτό το όνομα έχει τις ρίζες του στη λατινική λέξη 'benedictus', που προέρχεται από το ρήμα 'benedicere', που σημαίνει 'να ευλογεί'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας Ορθόδοξης και Καθολικής, το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με την έννοια της ευλογίας και της προστασίας από το Θεό.

in_latin.name: Benedek
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Benedek originem habet in lingua Latina, derivatum a verbo 'benedicere', quod significat 'benedicere' vel 'malleficus'. Nomen Benedictus, cui Benedek est equivalent, significat 'benedictus' vel 'qui benedictionem habet'. In ecclesia Christiana, hoc nomen est historicum et significat 'ille qui benedictionem Dei habet'.

in_english.name: Benedek
in_english.meaning: Benedek means blessed or one who is blessed
in_english.long_meaning: The name Benedek is of Christian origin, derived from the Latin name Benedictus, which means 'blessed'. It originates from the Latin words 'benedictus', meaning 'blessed', which comes from 'benedicere', meaning 'to bless'. Historically, the name has been associated with Saint Benedict, a 6th-century Christian saint who founded the Benedictine order. The name symbolizes a person who is blessed by God, conveying spiritual significance and divine favor. It is used across various Christian cultures and traditions.

data.cultural_impact: The name Benedek is deeply rooted in Hebrew and Judeo-Christian traditions. It evokes a sense of reverence and blessing, representing the hope that the bearer is favored by God. In Christian communities, the name is a reminder of the covenant between God and his people, emphasizing the importance of faith, trust, and obedience.
data.spiritual_significance: Benedek is a name steeped in spiritual meaning. It conveys a deep sense of faith and devotion, symbolizing the belief that God is the source of all blessings. For those who bear the name, it serves as a daily reminder of their relationship with the Divine and of the importance of living a life filled with gratitude and piety. In essence, it is a name that reflects a deep commitment to the spiritual journey and an example of the power of faith in shaping one's identity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Benedek, meaning "blessed" in Hebrew, symbolizes the divine favor and grace bestowed upon an individual, representing a life lived in God's blessings and favor. Spiritually, it signifies a deep connection with the divine, invoking blessings and prosperity in one's life.
